MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The small epoxy pack feels useful for a repair where my screws or anchors cannot secure the parts, without requiring a large supply.",
    "The two-roll weather-resistant tape fits the outdoor repair needs suggested by my deck screws and comes in a quantity I could reasonably use."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Locking nuts and metal-cutting wheels relate broadly to repair work, but my recent wood and drywall fasteners do not establish a bolt project or a need for a compatible cutting tool.",
    "The large epoxy pack, eighteen rolls of tape, and twelve wastebaskets require needs I have not shown; usefulness alone does not make those quantities appropriate.",
    "Neither temperature gun addresses a current task in my history, and the mounting tape would need a specific attachment job before I would choose it."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in fastening supplies seems to have been stretched into interest in almost any workshop or maintenance product.",
    "My purchases of boxes of nails and screws seem to have been treated as a reason to recommend bulk quantities of unrelated supplies, even though how quickly I use each product matters."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The material and task matter: fastening wood or drywall does not automatically create a need for metal cutting, bolt hardware, or temperature measurement.",
    "Quantity can change my decision even when the purpose fits: I would consider a small epoxy pack or two rolls of outdoor tape, but not a professional-size supply or eighteen rolls.",
    "My vacuum bags are explicitly replacement supplies; that kind of specific fit matters more to me than a broad connection to household maintenance."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly understood my practical repair needs but extended them too broadly across tools, tasks, and quantities."
}
